uzo.purpose: Names a page or section; its level is structure, its size is design.

instead.kialo: A bold paragraph that heads a section is a heading, because a screen reader reads the levels as the table of contents and a bold word is not in it; the titolo with its level says what the weight only shows.

boundary.kialo: A heading row with actions beside it is a pattern of the page, because the heading names the page and the actions act on it: the pagxo, whose title, badges and actions stand in that row with one primary at most.

containers.name: page-section
containers.kialo: A section of a page starts with its heading, because the heading is what a person skims and what a screen reader lists.

with.kialo: A dialog is named by its heading, because the heading says the decision it asks for; the dialog composes the titolo at level 2, its own document.
A notice may carry a heading over its message, because a heading lets a person skim what the notice is about; its heading is a text of the notice, no level of the page.
An empty state names what is missing in its text, because that sentence is what a person reads first; it is a text of the state, no level of the page.
A table is named by its caption, which stands visible above it, because the caption says what the rows are; the caption is the table's, no level of the page.

case.de: Neben der Überschrift sollen Aktionen und Etiketten der Seite stehen.
case.en: Actions and badges of the page are to stand beside the heading.

case.de: Der Text leitet keinen Abschnitt ein, er soll nur hervortreten.
case.en: The text heads no section; it is only to stand out.

do.de: Setze level nach dem Aufbau der Seite, ohne eine Ebene zu überspringen.
do.en: Set level by the structure of the page, without skipping a level.

do.de: Wähle size frei für das Aussehen; level bleibt die Struktur.
do.en: Choose size freely for the look; level stays the structure.

do.de: Setze focusable bei der Überschrift, auf die eine Anwendung nach einem Seitenwechsel den Fokus legt.
do.en: Set focusable on the heading an application puts the focus on after a change of page.

dont.de: Eine Ebene wählen, weil sie die passende Größe hat.
dont.en: Choose a level because it has the right size.

dont.de: Selbst eine Zeile aus Überschrift und Aktionen bauen; diese Zeile gehört der Seite (pagxo).
dont.en: Build a row of heading and actions yourself; that row belongs to the page (pagxo).

none.de: Die Überschrift nimmt keine Taste; mit focusable kann eine Anwendung ihr den Fokus geben, in der Tab-Reihenfolge steht sie trotzdem nicht.
none.en: The heading takes no key; with focusable an application can give it the focus, yet it does not stand in the tab order.
